title: Uncertified-Day Reversals in a Charged Coinsurance Block under Medicare Part A
content:
**Uncertified days in a coinsurance block — Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage.** A day reversed as an uncertified day is not a covered day: when the charged block's booked-days entry carries an uncertified-day reversal, the days of its span before the supplemental effective date come off the days the resident coinsurance charge counts before that date, all of the span when its last day falls before the date, the days from its first day up to the day before the date when the date falls after its first day and on or before its last, and none otherwise, in each case less the held nights and the hospital-day and leave-of-absence days inside that part of the span, which the reversal did not reverse; without such a reversal, none come off.

The records read are the reversal with the reason uncertified day posted against the charged block's booked-days entry (its span runs from its first to its last day, inside the charged block); the held nights of the bed-hold leave booked in the resident's Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations records for the same service month; and the days of any hospital-day or leave-of-absence reversal on the same entry.

### Input — judgement — output

| Position of the supplemental effective date | Part of the span considered | Days that come off |
|---|---|---|
| After the last day of the span | The whole span | The span's days less held nights, hospital-day and leave-of-absence days inside it |
| After the first day and on or before the last | From the first day up to the day before the date | That part's days less the held nights, hospital-day and leave-of-absence days inside that part |
| Any other position | None | None |

*Hypothetical worked example:* an uncertified-day reversal spans the 20th to the 25th, and a hospital-day reversal on the same entry covers the 22nd; no bed-hold leave falls in the span. With a supplemental effective date of the 24th, the part before the date is the 20th to the 23rd, four days, less the hospital day of the 22nd — three days come off. With a date of the 27th, the six days of the span less the 22nd — five days come off.
